history.summary: IDENTITY NOTE: the CSV row 'Swaminarayan Temple, Mumbai' is generic - Mumbai has several Swaminarayan temples (including a BAPS mandir at Dadar). This file documents the oldest and most famous, the Shri Swaminarayan Mandir at Bhuleshwar, a shikharband (tri-spire) mandir under the Laxminarayan Dev Gadi (Vadtal). On Vaishakh Shukla Ekadashi 1868, Ranchhoddas Pranjeevandas built Mumbai's first Swaminarayan temple by breaking down and rebuilding his own residence; Acharya Maharaj Bhagwatprasadji Maharaj instated the deities of Hari Krishna Maharaj, Gaulokvihari and Radhika. The present tri-spire structure was built and the deities of Ghanshyam Maharaj and Lakshminarayan Dev instated on Vaishakh Shukla Dwadashi 1903 by Acharya Maharaj Lakshmiprasadji Maharaj, with major support from devotee Rao Bahadur Sheth Curumsey Damjee and a Rs. 25,000 donation from Shree Mathurdas Vaishnav. The temple has an elaborately carved frontage, 25 steps to the Sabhamandap, and a dome on 54 pillars painted with Krishnalila scenes. It is credited with giving rise to Bhuleshwar's Phool Galli (flower market) due to the high flower demand of its temples.

town_description: Mumbai is the capital of Maharashtra and India's financial capital, a densely built coastal metropolis on reclaimed islands. Bhuleshwar, in South Mumbai near Crawford Market and Kalbadevi, is one of the city's oldest neighbourhoods, famous for its dense cluster of historic temples and the Phool Galli (flower market) that serves them, as well as the nearby Mumbadevi Temple that gave the city its name.

travel.airport: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport, Mumbai; approx. 22-25 km by road (verify).
travel.railway: Nearest local stations: Charni Road and Grant Road (Western Railway), approx. 1-2 km; Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus approx. 3 km (verify).
travel.road: Bhuleshwar is in South Mumbai near Crawford Market, served by BEST buses, taxis and auto-rickshaws; lanes are narrow and congested - walking is common for the last stretch.

visitor_information.best_time: October to February for pleasant weather. Swaminarayan Jayanti (Ram Navami) and Janmashtami are the grandest celebrations; Hindola in Shravan is also a major attraction.
